note: KDWP state fishing lake 2.5 miles south and 2 miles west of Stockton. Four designated camping areas with picnic tables along the east shoreline; the vault toilet and boat ramp are at the north entry, the group shelter at the middle entry. The lake periodically goes dry; the camping area by the ramp and toilet stays open then. Part of the area is closed to vehicles Nov. 1-Mar. 1. Pack out all trash; no alcohol. --Claude
